title: Marketplace publisher partner quickstart and contract clipboard
summary: Compact playbook for onboarding publisher partners into cloud marketplaces focused on bundled SKUs, contract headroom, technical gating, and go-live preflight. Meant as a 1-page quickstart + contract clipboard for PMs, partnerships, and legal to use during partner intake calls.
purpose: Create a minimal, repeatable checklist and short contract vocabulary so marketplace listings can be produced faster, legal can scope risk quickly, and GTM/partner teams have a consistent tile + entitlements pattern for publisher partners (esp. vertical ISVs and platform integrators).
target_audience: Partnership managers, partner PMs, GTM ops, marketplace program managers, legal review lead, partner engineers.
marketplace_requirements: Tile assets: 1 hero image (1600x900), 3 thumbnails (800x450), transparent logo (600x600) – PNG/JPEG/SVG accepted per vendor
SKU model: Mandatory trial SKU + paid SKU mapping. Trial duration: 14/30/60 configurable. Metering dimension: monthly seat or compute minutes.
Legal hooks: Master reseller clause, data processing addendum (DPA) or pointer to existing customer DPA, indemnity cap guidance (prefer < 1x annual committed spend), export control statement.
Security: SOC2 or ISO attestation file link, minimal network topology note for VPC/private deployments, contact for penetration test report on request.
Billing: Marketplace metering contract id, seller account email, refund policy and prorate rules, billing contact.
Trial provisioning: API key exchange endpoint, webhook for provisioning success/failure, sandbox cluster URL and test credentials.
Compliance: Any vertical-specific claims (HIPAA, FedRAMP) must be labeled and have corresponding artifacts attached under 'supporting docs'.
Localization: Primary listing in en-US, optional translations: en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP. Minimum translated elements: short blurb, hero headline, CTA label.
Integration links: Quickstart doc URL (must be < 5 steps), example terraform/provider snippet, SDK sample link for provisioning customers via marketplace provisioning webhook.
copy_snippets: Tile headline (short): High-performance LLM inference for product teams — predictable latency, lower cost
Tile subhead (short): Dedicated capacity, hosted API, or private VPC; production-grade SLAs and telemetry out-of-the-box

Long description (marketplace listing): Redwood Inference provides a unified inference runtime tailored for production LLM workloads. Ship reliably with hosted APIs for fast experiments, reserved dedicated pools for predictable throughput, or private deployments for regulated data — all instrumented with token-level cost, model rollout controls, and fallback routing. Get started with a 30-day trial, automatic onboarding, and sample prompts tuned to your use case.
CTA (trial): Start 30-day trial — no credit card required
CTA (contact): Request enterprise SSO & Private Deployment

Feature bullets (3): 1) Predictable per-token economics with batching and KV caching, 2) SLA-backed dedicated capacity and autoscaling policies, 3) Observability: token-level cost, traces, and regression alerts

Short FAQ snippet: Does this work on-prem? Yes — Redwood Private supports air-gapped installs and VPC-hosted control planes. Need SOC2/HIPAA compliance? Attach DPA and we’ll propose the compliance add-on.

Elevator pitch for partners: Embed Redwood as your inference backend to reduce time-to-market for LLM features — we handle latency, cost controls, rollout policies, and observability so your product team can focus on prompts and UX.
acceptance_checklist: GTM owner assigned and contact listed in listing metadata
Legal review: DPA present or reference to customer DPA; indemnity and liability sections pre-approved
Security: SOC2 attestation or equivalent uploaded; security contact for marketplace vendor review assigned
Billing: Seller account and metering dimension configured and verified in sandbox
Trial provisioning: Provisioning webhook verified end-to-end; sandbox customer created via marketplace flow
Copy QA: Tile headline, subhead, and long description approved by PR/brand; screenshots verified for correct size and content
Localization: At least en-US completed; additional languages flagged if requested by partner
E2E test: Purchase + trial activation + SaaS provisioning run with partner engineer present
Telemetry: Initial observability dashboard link included in listing; support escalation path noted
Rollback plan: Reversion procedure documented (unpublish tile, revoke trial SKUs, customer notification template)
Legal posting: Legal contact and required contract IDs entered into marketplace console
contract_clipboard: Suggested reseller clause (snippet): 'Partner may resell Redwood Inference subscriptions under Partner’s brand subject to Redwood’s reseller guidelines and reseller agreement. Redwood remains the service provider to the end customer for data processing obligations.'

Suggested trial clause: 'Trial subscriptions provided via marketplace will be converted to paid subscriptions only after explicit customer acceptance of paid terms; minimum trial-to-paid transition notice shall be 7 days.'
Data processing pointer: 'Customer data processed in accordance with Redwood DPA v3.0: link to DPA. For Private deployments customer-managed KMS is available.'
Indemnity guidance: 'Standard mutual indemnity; Redwood requests an indemnity cap equal to the greater of $500k or 1x annualized subscription revenue for the contract.'

Egress/usage terms: 'Marketplace metering dimensions and overage rules must be attached in schedule A. Overage billing applies at the listed per-unit price and billed monthly via marketplace mechanism.'
rollout_notes: Plan: 2-week partner pilot -> sandbox smoke tests with partner engineers -> 4-week open beta in select regions -> full publish. Primary KPIs: trial-to-paid conversion, time-to-provision (target < 5m), ticket volume in first 30 days. Coordinate launch with cloud marketplace marketing (creative asset deadline = T-10 business days).
testing_matrix: Provisioning: verify webhook receipts, provisioning success, failure path and retry behavior
Billing: simulate trial start, conversion to paid, prorate test, refund flow
Security: verify access only to correct tenant, rotate keys test, private deployment network test
Localization: validate UI strings in en-US and at least one additional locale if requested
Telemetry: ensure events emitted for trial start, provisioning complete, model variant fallback
open_questions: Does the partner require marketplace-native SSO or will SAML/OpenID connect be handled outside the marketplace?
Are there regional export control constraints for models used in partner bundles (e.g., China/Taiwan restrictions)?
Does legal want a separate master reseller schedule per partner or a single addendum template?
Should trial SKUs be auto-extended for enterprise partners or require manual uplift?
